info.schedule: Online, usually a minimum-bid round in July or August and a no-reserve round in the fall
info.note: Catalogs, inspector notes, photos and results come from Title Check's tax-sale.info, which runs the auctions for most Michigan treasurers. County value is twice the State Equalized Value (SEV), since Michigan sets SEV at half of market value.

parcels.desc: Property is a campground lot in pleasure point. Technically a condominium resort. Nice little campground with some lake access and a playground and other amenities. The Park said most of the RV's are not with the deeds and the RV would be considered personal property, so it is not part of what is being sold. Bring a new RV and this would be a nice little getaway for somebody or a retirement spot!
